about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Transferred Sixth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Nourished by Your heavenly food, O Lord, we beseech You that we may always strive after those things that give us true life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
